description: True server-side LOD: shader-only pack pushed once, all world data streams as sky-grid dust particles (SKY-GRID BIT-STREAM). No Display entities, no textures, no repacks. Live edits ride the stream (event push + delta beats); capture lens observes the client decode; CI verdicts publish to the ci-verdicts branch; the visual harness preflights the client renderer (a dead pipeline aborts the run as INVALID instead of framing the transport); voxy-reference shots publish to the voxy-ref branch (no API quota); the marcher SSAO is the cited port of voxy post/ssao.comp; the renderer preflight disambiguates a dead pipeline (lens_zero=1) from pool saturation; the verdict feed carries four downscaled screenshots + the GL stack version per run, the voxy feed carries a step-traced failure marker on every zero-shot outcome; the visual-control job runs the same client pack-free (CLOD_CONTROL=1) as the differential arm that separates a pack-caused frozen frame from an environment-caused one. v6.8.6: every silent death is named — the voxy leg and the control pulse tee their whole stdout/stderr into leg logs the failure markers carry, every stage traces into the steps logs, and the Paper download retries with the API's own words on any refusal. v6.8.7: the #227 control kill is ROOT-CAUSED and reproduced byte-exact — Paper 26.3's first boot appends white-list=true to a minimal server.properties (offline client kicked at login, 'You are not whitelisted on this server!', 43 bytes, proven by the protocol probe ctl_login_probe.py); every dist now writes white-list=false + enforce-secure-profile=false explicitly, the voxy leg's self-copy cp bug (the real <=1s killer) is guarded, and the control failure marker carries the server's own disconnect lines.
